configurations.name: 默认配置
configurations.description: 自动创建的默认工具配置

tools.name: scene_management
tools.description: 场景管理：获取当前场景信息、列出所有场景、打开/关闭场景、创建新场景、保存场景

tools.name: scene_hierarchy
tools.description: 获取当前场景的完整节点层级结构，支持可选的组件信息展示

tools.name: node_query
tools.description: Query and find nodes in the scene. Use for searching nodes by name pattern, finding nodes by exact name, getting detailed node info, listing all nodes, or detecting if a node is 2D/3D.

tools.name: node_lifecycle
tools.description: Create or delete nodes in the scene. Supports creating empty nodes, nodes with components, or instantiating from assets (prefabs, etc.). For creation, you should always provide parentUuid to specify where to create the node.

tools.name: node_transform
tools.description: Set node properties or transform (position, rotation, scale). Use set_property for general properties like active, name, layer. Use set_transform for position/rotation/scale with unified 2D/3D handling.

tools.name: node_hierarchy
tools.description: Move or duplicate nodes in the scene hierarchy. Move re-parents a node. Duplicate creates a copy of a node.

tools.name: component_manage
tools.description: Add or remove a component on a node. Use action "add" to add a component, action "remove" to remove one. For remove, componentType must be the component's classId (cid, i.e. the type field from getComponents), not the script name or class name.

tools.name: component_script
tools.description: Attach or detach a script component to/from a node. Use action "attach" to attach a script, action "detach" to detach one.

tools.name: component_query
tools.description: Query component information. Use action "get_all" to get all components of a node, "get_info" to get specific component info, "get_available" to list available component types by category.

tools.name: set_component_property
tools.description: Set component property values for UI components or custom script components. Supports setting properties of built-in UI components (e.g., cc.Label, cc.Sprite) and custom script components. Note: For node basic properties (name, active, layer, etc.), use set_node_property. For node transform properties (position, rotation, scale, etc.), use set_node_transform.

tools.name: configure_click_event
tools.description: Configure or remove click events on a cc.Button component. Use action "set" to configure a click event handler, action "remove" to clear all click events.

tools.name: prefab_browse
tools.description: Browse prefab assets: list prefabs in a folder, load a prefab, get detailed info, or validate a prefab file format.

tools.name: prefab_lifecycle
tools.description: Create or duplicate a prefab. Use action "create" to create a prefab from a node, "duplicate" to duplicate an existing prefab.

tools.name: prefab_instance
tools.description: Manage prefab instances: instantiate a prefab in the scene, unlink a prefab instance, apply changes back to the prefab source, or revert an instance to original.

tools.name: prefab_edit
tools.description: Enter prefab edit mode, save changes, or exit prefab edit mode. These actions allow editing prefab contents directly in the scene editor.

tools.name: project_manage
tools.description: 项目管理：运行项目预览、构建项目、获取项目信息和设置

tools.name: project_build_system
tools.description: 项目构建系统：控制构建面板、检查构建状态、管理预览服务器

tools.name: debug_console
tools.description: 编辑器控制台操作：获取控制台日志、清空控制台

tools.name: debug_logs
tools.description: 项目日志操作：获取项目日志文件内容、获取日志文件信息、搜索日志

tools.name: debug_system
tools.description: 调试系统操作：获取编辑器信息、获取性能统计、验证场景、获取节点树

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in scene context

tools.name: preferences_manage
tools.description: 偏好设置管理：打开设置面板、查询配置、设置配置、重置偏好

tools.name: preferences_query
tools.description: 偏好设置查询：获取所有偏好、列出分类、按关键词搜索

tools.name: preferences_backup
tools.description: 偏好设置备份：导出和导入偏好配置

tools.name: server_information
tools.description: 服务器信息：查询IP地址列表、排序IP列表、端口、基本状态

tools.name: server_connectivity
tools.description: 服务器连接与网络：检查连接状态、获取网络接口

tools.name: broadcast_log_management
tools.description: 广播日志管理：获取广播消息日志、清空日志

tools.name: broadcast_listener_management
tools.description: 广播监听管理：开始监听、停止监听、获取活跃监听器列表

tools.name: node_clipboard
tools.description: Copy, paste, or cut nodes in the scene. Copy stores nodes for later paste. Paste creates duplicates at a target parent. Cut copies and marks nodes for move.

tools.name: scene_execution_control
tools.description: Execute component methods, scene scripts, or restore prefab instances. Use for invoking runtime methods on components, running scene scripts, or reverting prefab changes.

tools.name: scene_state_management
tools.description: Manage scene state: create/abort snapshots, begin/end/cancel undo recording, or soft reload the scene. Use for state preservation and undo support.

tools.name: scene_query_system
tools.description: Query scene state and metadata. Check if scene is ready or dirty, list registered classes, query available components, check component scripts, or find nodes using a specific asset.

tools.name: node_property_management
tools.description: Reset node properties, transforms, or entire components to their default values.

tools.name: node_array_management
tools.description: Manage array properties on nodes: move array elements by offset or remove elements at specific indices.

tools.name: scene_view_gizmo_management
tools.description: Gizmo management: change tool type, pivot point, coordinate system, view alignment mode

tools.name: scene_view_mode_control
tools.description: View mode control: switch 2D/3D view, manage grid display

tools.name: scene_view_icon_gizmo
tools.description: IconGizmo management: set 3D/2D mode, adjust size

tools.name: scene_view_camera_control
tools.description: Camera control: focus camera on nodes, align camera, align view

tools.name: scene_view_status_management
tools.description: Scene view status: get comprehensive status, reset to default

tools.name: reference_image_management
tools.description: Reference image management: add, remove, switch, clear reference images

tools.name: reference_image_query
tools.description: Reference image query: get configuration, current image data, list available images

tools.name: reference_image_transform
tools.description: Reference image transform: set position, scale, opacity

tools.name: reference_image_display
tools.description: Reference image display: refresh display, set image data

tools.name: asset_manage
tools.description: 资源管理：导入、删除资源，保存元数据，生成可用URL

tools.name: asset_analyze
tools.description: 资源分析：获取资源依赖关系、获取未使用资源列表

tools.name: asset_system
tools.description: 资源系统：检查资源数据库状态、刷新资源数据库、用外部程序打开资源

tools.name: asset_query
tools.description: 资源查询：搜索资源、获取资源详情

tools.name: asset_operations
tools.description: 资源文件操作：创建、复制、移动、删除、保存、导入资源

tools.name: validate_json_params
tools.description: Validate and fix JSON parameters before sending to other tools

tools.name: safe_string_value
tools.description: Create a safe string value that won't cause JSON parsing issues

tools.name: format_mcp_request
tools.description: Format a complete MCP request with proper JSON escaping

tools.name: visual_verification
tools.description: 视觉校验工具：捕获场景截图并与设计效果图对比，返回结构化差异报告。支持三种模式：capture(仅截图)、compare(仅对比)、verify(截图+对比)。
